note: Who has the exact problem each axis's data answers, and the standards or regulatory hook where the connection is real. This file is analyst input to scripts/axis-doors-probe.mjs, not a measurement: nothing here is derived from an endpoint and nothing here is a claim about any buyer having bought. 'none identified' is a first-class answer. Axis ids are the board's own; the probe refuses an id the board does not carry.

governance.buyer: AI Act compliance lead at a provider or deployer who must place a system in a risk tier (Art. 6 / Annex III) and defend the classification
governance.hook: EU AI Act Art. 6 + Annex III (high-risk classification); Art. 5 (prohibited practices)
governance.x402_door: commission_card / api/request-attestation (a signed card for a named subject on this frozen bank)
governance.gap: No public leader (own model led); the buyer gets a fleet mean and harm tail, not a vendor ranking

safety.buyer: Model provider trust-and-safety / red-team lead measuring over- and under-refusal on paired requests
safety.hook: none identified (NIST AI 600-1 lists refusal calibration as a suggested action, not a requirement)
safety.gap: Leader is a TIE; the sellable result is the paired-item card, not a rank

provenance.buyer: Provider of a generative system that must mark outputs machine-readably, and the platform ingesting them
provenance.hook: EU AI Act Art. 50(2) (machine-readable marking of synthetic content); C2PA manifests
provenance.x402_door: api/evidence-bundle?obligation=article-50 (OSCAL bundle of already-signed cards); art50_marking_evidence for a named URL

continuity.buyer: CISO / crypto-agility programme owner asking whether an assistant reasons correctly about post-quantum status of an assumption
continuity.hook: NIST FIPS 203/204/205 and NIST IR 8547 transition timeline (the facts the bank grades against)

conformance.buyer: MCP host, gateway or tool-platform team checking whether a model honours tool contracts
conformance.hook: none identified (the Model Context Protocol specification is the reference; no regulatory hook)

openness.buyer: OSPO / open-source compliance counsel deciding whether a licence matches an intended use, incl. the GPAI open-source carve-out
openness.hook: EU AI Act Art. 53(2) free-and-open-source GPAI exemption; OSI Open Source AI Definition

machinery-conformity.buyer: Machinery OEM regulatory-affairs lead and notified bodies classifying self-evolving safety functions
machinery-conformity.hook: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (Machinery), Annex I Part A self-evolving behaviour (mandatory third-party assessment from 20 Jan 2027)
machinery-conformity.gap: Public leader dropped: no signed per-model card in the index

care.buyer: Consumer-facing assistant provider weighing protect-versus-help conduct under paired scenarios
care.hook: none identified with confidence (adjacent, unverified: EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(b) vulnerable-group exploitation)

cross-reality.buyer: Agent-platform / computer-use product team deciding when an autonomous action needs confirmation
cross-reality.hook: EU AI Act Art. 14 human oversight (only where the deployment is high-risk)
cross-reality.gap: Public leader dropped: no signed per-model card in the index

detector-interop.buyer: Watermark and detector vendors, and platforms that must detect marks from other vendors' generators
detector-interop.hook: EU AI Act Art. 50(2) wording: marking must be 'effective, interoperable, robust and reliable'
detector-interop.gap: Public leader dropped: no signed per-model card in the index

art5-safeguard.buyer: Deployer compliance / DPO checking whether a system trips an Art. 5 prohibited practice
art5-safeguard.hook: EU AI Act Art. 5 (applies since 2 Feb 2025)

swarm.buyer: Multi-agent orchestration vendor measuring coordination safety across agents
swarm.gap: Separation UNTESTED: a point leader without a paired test

affect.buyer: Companion / assistant app provider and its trust-and-safety lead (manipulation, disclosure, vulnerability)
affect.hook: EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(a) manipulation, Art. 5(1)(f) emotion recognition in workplace/education, Art. 50(1) disclosure of AI interaction

jail.buyer: Agent sandbox / runtime-security team that needs an escape-attempt detector with a known false-positive rate
jail.hook: EU AI Act Art. 15 robustness (only where high-risk); otherwise none identified
jail.gap: Recall of the best zero-FP detector is low; the honest result is the miss rate

effect-binding.buyer: MCP server operators, agent-gateway and enterprise IAM teams asking whether authorization binds to the executed request
effect-binding.hook: MCP authorization specification (OAuth 2.1, RFC 8707 resource indicators); regulatory: none identified
effect-binding.x402_door: none per-axis (mcp_trust is the free census; the signed probe artifact is the result)
effect-binding.gap: No Hub bank (server probe, not a bank); the evidence artifact 404s on the edge today and is only reachable from the mirror; no per-axis page until this branch deploys

provenance-controls.buyer: Exchange listing / due-diligence analyst and RWA issuer needing on-ledger control facts (freeze, allowlist, domain)
provenance-controls.hook: GENIUS Act (US, 2025) requirement that a permitted issuer can freeze/seize; MiCA issuer obligations indirectly
provenance-controls.gap: n=6 instruments; unsigned run artifact was upgraded to Ed25519 on the board

reserve-attestation.buyer: Exchange listing team, treasurer or risk lead wanting an independent read of whether reserve-attestation language exists
reserve-attestation.hook: MiCA Title III/IV reserve-of-assets rules; GENIUS Act monthly reserve reports examined by a registered accounting firm; NYDFS June 2022 reserve guidance
reserve-attestation.gap: 9 of 16 UNCHECKABLE (no on-chain Domain); risk verdict UNMEASURED by design

regulatory-framework.buyer: Exchange or custodian compliance lead confirming which regime an issuer declares
regulatory-framework.hook: MiCA authorisation (EMT/ART issuers); GENIUS Act permitted-issuer status; NYDFS
regulatory-framework.gap: Declaration presence only, never compliance; 9 of 16 UNCHECKABLE

distribution-integrity.buyer: Market-structure analyst or listing team reading chain supply and holder distribution
distribution-integrity.hook: none identified (supply and holder facts feed MiCA significance thresholds but no article requires this reading)
distribution-integrity.gap: represented-vs-distributed stays UNCHECKABLE without a same-unit pair

custody-disclosure.buyer: Exchange listing / treasury lead checking whether a custodian and auditor are named and confirmable
custody-disclosure.hook: MiCA Art. 37 custody of reserve assets; GENIUS Act reserve custody and audit provisions
custody-disclosure.gap: Disclosure only, never custodian quality; 9 of 16 UNCHECKABLE

ai-adoption-components.buyer: Policy analyst or macro strategist citing EU AI-adoption series with a recomputable source
ai-adoption-components.x402_door: none per-axis (api/eunomia-data?feed=1 is the only data feed door and is not axis-scoped)
ai-adoption-components.gap: Two public series, not an index; bank dataset keeps the retired name gspc-ai-economy-index

labour-components.buyer: Policy analyst or macro strategist citing EU labour series with a recomputable source
labour-components.gap: Two public series, not an index; bank dataset keeps the retired name gspc-human-labour-index

humanoid-labour-index.buyer: Robotics analyst or investor checking whether a vendor publishes a dated deployment count on a stable URL
humanoid-labour-index.gap: Disclosure facts on 8 frozen URLs; fleet size, hours and incidents stay UNMEASURED
